title: MA2H Message (v0.5)
description: Agent->Hub message envelope. Discriminated on `type`; cross-type fields are forbidden per branch. `id` is Hub-assigned and is NOT an input. v0.5 adds the optional `to` (inter-agent addressing, spec §4/S2 grammar: first `#` terminates the agent-id segment; the session segment matches `^sess_`) and `agent.session` (spec §4.1, §16).

to.description: Optional destination (v0.5, spec §4): `agent:<id>` (principal-addressed) or `agent:<id>#<session>` (session-addressed). Absent = the human inbox, unchanged. `to: human:...` is invalid in 0.5. A `#`-bearing agent id is inexpressible here (its first `#` parses as the separator and the remainder must match `^sess_`). The Hub validates the destination at accept time (422 unknown_destination / 410 destination_gone, spec §8.1/§8.5).

body.description: Human-readable Markdown detail. Untrusted: the Hub sanitizes to a no-raw-HTML profile before rendering (spec §9.6). Length is capability-advertised via max_body_bytes, not constrained here.

state.description: Opaque, agent-owned, agent-integrity-sealed resume blob. Hub MUST NOT inspect or log.

client_ref.description: Opaque correlation label. Never a dedup key. Not exposed to resolvers.

idempotency_key.description: Dedup key, scope (agent.id, idempotency_key). REQUIRED for ask/task.

sensitive.description: Message-level sensitivity; excludes value(s) from export/telemetry.

allOf.$comment: >= 0.5 envelopes: agent-form allowed_resolvers entries follow the §4 address grammar (spec §9.1 matching). Pre-0.5 envelopes keep the legacy pattern — hash-bearing principals stay valid for human-inbox traffic (unchanged-wire contract).

`to` and `agent.session` are v0.5 features: an envelope carrying either MUST declare minor >= 5, so the validator never approves a submission whose delivered form (the >= 0.5 inter-agent entry branch of inbound-message.schema.json) could not validate. The same conditional rejects a `#`-bearing agent.id on an addressed/session-bearing submit (spec §4): the Hub would have to attest a `from` the first-#-splits grammar cannot represent — such principals cannot participate in the inter-agent leg (they also cannot register sessions or be addressed).

session.description: Optional registered session of the authenticated principal (v0.5, spec §4.1/§16). Foreign/unknown -> 422; own-but-terminal -> 410. When present, the Caller's mailbox for Response delivery is this session (spec §6). Excluded (with run_id) from the §8.1 idempotency identical-payload comparison.

schema.description: Flat JSON Schema for mode=input (string/number/boolean/enum). Properties MAY carry `x-ma2h-sensitive: true`.

default_on_expire.description: For select: MUST be a member of options[].value (Hub-enforced + conformance vector). For input: an object validating against `schema`, or null.

allowed_resolvers.description: Who may resolve (spec §9.1). On a >= 0.5 envelope an agent-form entry follows the §4 address grammar (the root conditional): principal form matches any session of that principal; a session-qualified form (#sess_...) matches only that exact session — a malformed agent entry could never match an attested actor, leaving the message unresolvable. Pre-0.5 envelopes keep the legacy v0.4 pattern (hash-bearing principals remain valid for human-inbox traffic).
